Records.description: massless propagator computed for the $\varphi^4$ 6-loop calculation available from the ancillary files p_int_g2.mpl (Maple) and p_int_g2.m (Mathematica) of the arXiv submission results are rational linear combinations of multiple zeta values. The pInt[5,3] period for this 5-loop 9-propagator topology is imported here as a Result: value = Cfull^5 * (anc g2 period), the G-scheme -> SubTropica normalization conversion, with the overall sign inherited from the ancillary period (Cfull -> 1 as eps -> 0). Independently validated by pySecDec single-scale Euclidean integration at p^2=-1 (magnitude and transcendental structure at every order; method-independent of the HyperInt reduction that produced the ancillary value).
Records.verifiedVia: pySD-Euclidean s=-1: independent pySecDec single-scale Euclidean integration at p^2=-1 (sector decomposition; method-independent of the HyperInt reduction that produced the ancillary value) reproduces the MAGNITUDE and full transcendental structure of value_ST at every Laurent order eps^-3..eps^1 to Monte-Carlo accuracy. pySD-Euclidean s=-1 (NESO, processes=8, geometric, prefactor exp(5eps*gammaE)) reproduces -value_ST at every order eps^-3..eps^1; sigma=-1; max rel dev 7.0e-09. The pySD-raw output equals -value_ST, differing by the single overall convention sign sigma = -1 = (-1)^nu_tot = (-1)^9 of the Euclidean (-F)^(-omega) branch for this s=-1 driver (NOT an independent sign check). The stored sign is inherited from the ancillary G-scheme period through Cfull^L (Cfull -> 1 as eps -> 0). The Cfull normalization is independently anchored at 2 loops by a first-principles massless-bubble recursion. NOT validated against HyperFLINT/STIntegrate (a HyperInt reimplementation -> circular). bridge confirmed by explicit vertex isomorphism {1->5, 2->3, 3->4, 4->1, 5->2} (anc->lib; brute-force).

source.title: Minimally subtracted six loop renormalization of O(n)-symmetric phi^4 theory and critical exponents
source.ancFile: anc/p_int_g2.m -> pInt[5,3]  (g2 = genuine phi^4 propagator periods)

import.method: Single-scale phi^4 propagator integral, external scale restored. value = (p^2)^{1 - 5 eps} * Cfull^5 * anc[pInt[5,3]]: the KP G-scheme period series (Cfull = Exp[eps*EulerGamma] Gamma[1+eps] Gamma[1-eps]^2/Gamma[2-2eps], G-scheme -> SubTropica normalization per loop) with the external Euclidean invariant restored, so the stored value is the dimensionful momentum-space integral, not the p^2=1 reduced form. g2: genuine phi^4 propagator self-energy; 2L-V=1; I ~ (p2)^{1 - 5 eps}; mass dimension (mass)^2. p2 = -MM > 0 : the spacelike (mostly-plus) external invariant, = minus the package mostly-minus Euclidean MM (MM<0; conventions.md L918-924). value = (p2)^{1 - 5 eps} * (dimensionless p2=1 form) is REAL for p2>0 (KP G-scheme). At the pySD anchor MM=-1, i.e. p2=+1, the scale factor is 1, reproducing the anchored period; the i*pi tower appears only on continuation to timelike p2<0 (MM>0). NOT computed by STIntegrate/HyperFLINT (a HyperInt reimplementation; using it to validate the ancillary HyperInt value would be circular).
